name: Minori
source:
"The way she's floundering through her first love... Isn't it just sooo adorable!?"

Another of Yuuto's childhood friends and older sister figures. Despite her calm demeanor and gentle manner of speech, Minori is the more impulsive one when romance is involved. She loves to chit-chat about the love lives of others even more than she does about her own.

As the poster girl of Hinata Diner, which serves the best food in town, she has a firm grip on the local community through their stomachs. Since her mother is pregnant, she's running the restaurant practically on her own. She and Iori were born on the same day and grew up together as bosom buddies.

[From [url=https://kanade.frontwing.co.jp/en/]official website[/url]]
